scripts.name: Lumber Wagon
scripts.summary: Carry harvested timber from camp to mill or town center.
scripts.description: Loads timber from this lot, follows connected roads to a Lumber Mill or Town Center, unloads, and returns. Place the wagon on clear ground within 24m of a road. Assign receiver lots through Deliveries.
